title: Casper and the Tide
author: Gideon Okafor
blurb: Vesper Halloran, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
